title: Blackbox AI Pricing: Plans, Credits and Costs (2026)
summary: Blackbox AI pricing includes five tiers: free, Pro, Pro Plus, Pro Max, and enterprise. Identify which tier suits your team's budget and usage patterns.
body_markdown:
## Where Activepieces Fits Around an AI Coding Tool


Activepieces can warn you that a limit is coming, but it can't set, raise or replace a limit inside Blackbox AI. It's a workflow automation tool, not a coding assistant, so it isn't an alternative to Blackbox AI.


What it brings is 747 integrations, counted from its MIT-licensed open source core, to carry that warning to wherever your team already works, which means the warning reaches your team no matter what tools you use.


### What capabilities get unified together?


Activepieces covers agents, integrations, workflow automation, shared team data, an AI chat and MCP tools with approvals in a single product, and access to all of it is handled by the same custom RBAC, SSO, SCIM, audit logs and git sync.


Integrate that together from point tools and every part arrives with its own vendor, its own bill and its own trail to dig through when something breaks, which is a poor trade for a chore meant to keep the invoice small.


MoneyGram, Moneypenny, Alan and FundingSocieties run it in production, and it still has no say in how many requests or credits your Blackbox AI plan includes.


Those limits stay where they are, and your bill is still decided by them.


What it can do is take chores off whoever watches the invoice. If nobody is assigned to watch usage, the cost of doing nothing is a surprise at month end.


Automating the watching is cheap by comparison, as long as you understand it only reports the problem and never fixes it.


[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/pricing) prices its own side the way this article asks you to price everything, by the limit: Free is $0 with 1,000 credits a month and unlimited flows, Plus is $20 a month with 10,000 credits, and Team is $200 a month with 50,000 credits and 25 users, as listed on activepieces.com on 2026-10-23.


### Usage alerts as a small example


Here are three jobs it can do around development, none of which lifts a Blackbox AI limit:


- Post a usage alert to Slack, the team chat, when consumption passes a threshold you choose, so the person who can act sees it the same day.
- Send a weekly spend summary to whoever owns the invoice, so the total is never a first-time discovery.
- Open a ticket when a seat has sat idle, so you stop paying for a chair nobody is using.


Read each job as a reminder with a name attached. The alert tells you the cap is close, and the summary tells you what you spent. The ticket tells you which seat to cancel.


You still have to make the decision, and the cap you set in the previous step is what actually protects the budget.
